messages:
emma_partnerships: Heads up — AuroraCloud PO AC-47 failed ingestion. Portal returned TAX_JURISDICTION_MISMATCH and blocked ACK. Customer needs appliances cleared for customs by Friday.

julio_procure: Pulling ledger: PO AC-47 shows billing entity AuroraCloud EU but submitted tax id looks like a US EIN. Validation rejects.

ops_bot: Automated alert: PO AC-47 validation error {code:451, reason: 'Tax jurisdiction mismatch: declared EU vs EIN country US'}.

liam_sales: Aurora says their finance team rolled two ERP instances (US + EU) and the EDI gateway sent the legacy EIN for older SKUs. They can produce a corrected EDI but ETA >24h. We need a short-term path.

vijay_vendor: From Aurora finance: we can provide a signed commercial invoice and a vendor statement (affidavit) confirming intended EU jurisdiction. Can that be accepted as an override?

nina_legal: We can allow a temporary manual acceptance if we have (1) signed commercial invoice, (2) vendor affidavit naming authorized signers and jurisdiction, and (3) an audit entry with procurement sign-off. Legal must receive docs in contracts@redwood.

julio_procure: Ops can patch vendor alias to accept alternative tax identifiers for AC-47 until corrected EDI arrives. That will push the ACK through but must be logged. Ops, can you queue alias patch?

ops_bot: alias-patch queued: alias-patch --vendor AURO --po AC-47 --allow-alt-tax=EIN-LEGACY,VAT-EU (job id 55100). ETA ~2m.

ops_bot: alias-patch completed (job id 55100). Portal retry requested.

liam_sales: Resend from Aurora portal shows ACK processed and PO state ACCEPTED. Customer notified.

emma_partnerships: Great. Procurement please upload the invoice & affidavit links here and note in PO ledger so Legal can close the temporary acceptance.

julio_procure: Uploaded invoice + affidavit: https://files.redwood/aurora/AC-47-invoice.pdf and https://files.redwood/aurora/AC-47-affidavit.pdf. Logged in PO ledger AC-47.

nina_legal: Received docs. Reviewing now. If everything matches I will clear the temporary note and add an audit entry. Expect closure in 2h.

emma_partnerships: Thanks everyone — keeping this open until legal sign-off, but portal accepted so shipment can proceed. If legal objects we will revert and escalate to partnerships manager.

liam_sales: Customer update: "Thanks — shipment cleared, will monitor customs."

vijay_vendor: Appreciate the fast help, team. We'll patch our gateway to send correct VAT for EU SKUs in next release.
